notes: עִמָּדִי → 'that ... take' kept on the preposition: the relative realizes the attributive relation of the prepositional phrase (rule 41 analog) and 'take' is what the ASV wrote in place of 'is with' (rule 49's relational-verb reading, margin corroborating); the alternative of an unrepresented preposition with 'that' and 'take' added is recorded in the unit note.
